content.short: Self-custodial money app with stablecoin payments and Mastercard.
content.description: Bleap, founded by former Revolut employees, is a self-custodial money app that lets users hold and spend stablecoins directly from their own smart wallet. Through a partnership with Mastercard, its non-custodial debit card converts stablecoins such as USDC, USDT, USDA, and EURA to fiat automatically at the point of sale, so people can pay anywhere while keeping funds on-chain. The smart wallet is deployed on Arbitrum, and Bleap's on/off-ramp and bridging services extend across Ethereum, Polygon, Base, Optimism, BNB Chain, Solana, and Bitcoin. Aimed at consumers in Europe and globally, Bleap blends a familiar neobank experience — cards, cashback, and savings yield — with DeFi rails, positioning stablecoins as everyday spending money.
content.meta: Bleap is a self-custodial app to spend stablecoins via a Mastercard debit card. Discover Bleap and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
